title: Writing / Style / Contractions
slide_intent: Use contractions when they sound natural while retaining full forms for emphasis so the reader hears the intended tone.
strategic_value: A permitted exception can help Duolingo maintain conversational copy without weakening an important warning.
demonstration: Three approved examples include two contractions and one emphatic full form, contrasted with mechanically expanded or contracted alternatives.
practical_value: Read the sentence aloud and decide whether a contraction improves naturalness or weakens the point.
